description: Webinar and event data from Demio - list events and their dates, register attendees, and read who attended each session.

api.description: Read one event with every date the filter allowed

fields.description: The event id from `events.list` or `events.get`.
Receive only dates that are scheduled or running. Demio reads any value other than its own `false` as `true`, so this is sent only when set.
True when registering once covers the whole series.

fields.type: { ready?: boolean | null, duration?: number | null } | null

fields.description: The first date that has not finished, if any.

fields.type: { date_id: number, status: string, timestamp?: number | null, datetime?: string | null, zone?: string | null }[]

api.description: Read one date of an event

fields.description: The event id from `events.list` or `events.get`.
The event date id from `events.get` or `events.getDate`.
`scheduled`, `running` or `finished`. Unlike `events.get`, an on-demand date reports `running` here rather than `on-demand`.
When the date starts, as a Unix timestamp. For an on-demand date, the moment you asked.
The date's stored start time, formatted in its zone. For an on-demand date this does not describe the same instant as `timestamp`.

api.description: List events, each collapsed to one representative date

fields.description: Narrows the list. Omit it to receive every event with its nearest date.

output.type: { id: number, labeled_name?: string | null, name: string, description?: string | null, date_id: number, status: string, timestamp: number, zone?: string | null, registration_url: string, automated?: { ready?: boolean | null, duration?: number | null } | null }[]

api.description: Check that the API key and secret are accepted

fields.description: True when the credentials are accepted.
Present and true only for a sandbox account.

api.description: Register a person for an event date and return their join link

fields.description: The event id. Give this or `ref_url`.
The event's registration page link. Give this or `id`.
The event date to register for. Omit it to use the event's next date.
The person's full name as one field. Demio rejects a name containing a URL.
The email address to register.
The registrant's identifier for this event date.
The link the person opens to join.

api.description: List who registered for a date, whether they attended, and their custom fields

fields.description: The event date id from `events.get` or `events.getDate`.
Narrows the list. Omit it to receive every registrant.

fields.type: { email: string, name: string, custom_fields: { id: string, name: string, value: string }[], attended: boolean, status: string }[]
